{{Top|leg}}
'''Iquar''' was a member of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]]. He took part in an operation to kidnap holovid star [[Janissa Locrin]], following [[Seland' Ir]]'s scheme. Later, in drunken stupor, Iquar inadvertently confessed both his implication and Ir's to the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]].
